name: Czechia
prevalence_note: Police ČR and ČNB warnings 2025-2026: fake bankers and police moving savings to a 'safe account' or a courier, crypto investment calls with remote access, and fake Citizen Portal fines.
cross_border_note: Vishing rings routinely spoof +420 bank helpdesks, ČNB, and Policie ČR numbers via VoIP (often routed from abroad) or contact victims on WhatsApp from foreign EU prefixes.

scams.name: Falešný bankéř nebo policista: převod na bezpečný účet
scams.name_en: Fake banker or police moving money to a safe account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department, the central bank or the police says the account was attacked and asks to move money to a safe account, take a pre-approved loan or hand cash to a courier.
scams.legit_en: Banks and the police never ask customers to move money to another account, take a loan or hand cash to a courier to protect it.
bait_tactics: Říct, že bankovní aplikace se ještě načítá, a poprosit, ať to vysvětlí ještě jednou pomalu
Zeptat se, která platba to byla a kterého dne

scams.name: Falešný investiční poradce: kryptoměny a vzdálená správa
scams.name_en: Fake investment adviser with crypto and remote access
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as an investment adviser promises crypto profits, asks to send money to a crypto wallet or install a remote-control program, then demands fees to pay out profits.
scams.legit_en: Licensed advisers never ask clients to install remote-control programs or pay fees before paying out profits.
bait_tactics: Říct, že si to musí zapsat, a zeptat se, kolik se platí na začátku
Zeptat se, jak dlouho trvá výplata

scams.name: Falešný Portál občana: nezaplacená pokuta
scams.signals_en: A caller or text says there is an unpaid fine or enforcement and asks to log in through a link or confirm the bank identity.
scams.legit_en: Czech authorities never ask anyone to confirm their bank identity through a link from a call or text.
bait_tactics: Říct, že hledá brýle, a zeptat se, za jaký přestupek ta pokuta je
Zeptat se, kterého dne se to stalo
